# FortiGate management 192.168.10.99 -> 192.168.5.99 (plan v2 step 0)
# Generated by plans/gen-fortigate-cli.py from the 13/14 Oct 2026 captures. Do not edit; re-run.
# Lines starting with # are comments for the reader; FortiOS ignores them when pasted.

# STEP 0, part 1: add the new management address alongside the old one. Nothing is removed.
# Run from the console or over SSH to 192.168.10.99. The old address keeps working.
config system interface
    edit "mgmt"
        set secondary-IP enable
        config secondaryip
            edit 1
                set ip 192.168.5.99 255.255.255.0
                set allowaccess ping https ssh
            next
        end
    next
end

# Then on the jump box (Mat present; touches the onboard NIC, not the USB NIC or Tailscale):
#   sudo nmcli con mod fortigate-mgmt +ipv4.addresses 192.168.5.98/24
#   sudo nmcli con up fortigate-mgmt
#   ping -c3 192.168.5.99 ; ssh ro-jumpbox@192.168.5.99 "get system status"
#   sudo tailscale set --advertise-routes=192.168.254.0/24,192.168.10.0/24,192.168.5.0/24
#   (approve 192.168.5.0/24 in the Tailscale admin console; test from the laptop)

# STEP 0, part 2: swap. FROM THE CONSOLE ONLY: this drops any SSH session on 192.168.10.99.
# Only after part 1 is proven from the laptop over Tailscale.
config system interface
    edit "mgmt"
        config secondaryip
            delete 1
        end
        set secondary-IP disable
        set ip 192.168.5.99 255.255.255.0
    next
end

# Jump box afterwards:
#   sudo nmcli con mod fortigate-mgmt ipv4.addresses 192.168.5.98/24
#   sudo nmcli con up fortigate-mgmt
#   sudo tailscale set --advertise-routes=192.168.254.0/24,192.168.5.0/24
#   edit HOST= in ~/jumpbox-setup/fortigate-cmd.sh and fortigate-discover.sh, private/jb.env, bin/jb status list
# Check: bin/jb fgt "get system interface physical" shows mgmt 192.168.5.99 and NO 192.168.10.x anywhere.
